test.name: An audit in a project that does not hold the person reports no warnings and says so in one line
test.description: Issue #2942, the other direction. The working folder holds a project for a different person (Patrick Flynn, I1, no ark), so its tree has no one whose id is KD96-TV2 or whose ark ends in 4:1:KD96-TV2. The impossible-date check runs only over a project tree that holds the audited person: person_warnings, called with KD96-TV2, answers 'not found', and the agent must neither retry under another id nor add the person to this project, which the user did not ask to change. The agent says in one line that the check runs only on a project that holds this person, and the source audit proceeds exactly as it would anywhere else.

input.delegation:
Go through the sources attached to Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) and tell me whether they are right.

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Should call person_read for KD96-TV2, record_read each source carrying a record ARK, and person_quality with detail: true for KD96-TV2. A single person_warnings call is expected and answers 'not found': the project in the working folder is about Patrick Flynn and holds no one matching KD96-TV2. Not calling it at all is also acceptable; retrying it under another id after 'not found' is not.
The reply should say, in one line, that impossible-date checks run only on a project that holds this person. It must not suggest adding Christian Hole to this project, and must not invent warnings.

The source audit itself is the Hole corpus: the Minnesota Death Index is an index error (1954 against 1945, a nine-year difference) to be re-read, not detached; the 1885 Minnesota State Census is misattributed and is the one source to detach; the 1900 census birth-year drift is ordinary variance; the uploaded funeral card is reported as unchecked. Grade the audit against the four-fact profile person_read returned.
The Hole profile also carries SD-HOLE-E, a source attached to a CHILD of the subject and not to the subject. It is outside the audit list, so the reply must not report it at all.
